newsitem.title: USA: Albright urges Mideast leaders to calm region.
newsitem.headline: Albright urges Mideast leaders to calm region.

text.p: U.S. Secretary of State Madeleine Albright urged Arab and Israeli leaders to calm the situation in the Middle East following Thrusday's shooting of seven Israeli schoolchildren by a Jordanian soldier.

"We call upon all leaders in the region to calm the situation, to do their utmost to prevent future violence in any form and to redouble their efforts to forge a just and lasting peace," she said in a written statement.
"We condemn this cowardly act in the strongest possible terms. Violence can never be an answer. It can only produce more victims," she said.
Albright said the death of innocent schoolchildren was "especially heartrending".
"The loss of children is particularly tragic because it is through the peace process that we are trying to create for them a better future," she said, adding her condolences to the victims' families.
President Bill Clinton earlier condemned the shooting as "inexcusable and tragic".
